brief_summary: Objectives: To investigate the treatment effect between insulin,metformin and Liraglutide; in Type 2 Diabetes in our hospital, in order to investigate the possible mechanism about telomere-telomerase system and Par-4.
brief_title: Par-4 and Telomere-telomerase System in Type 2 Diabetes Patients Who Received GLP-1 or Metformin Treatment
official_title: The Correlation Between Par-4 and Telomere-telomerase System in the New Dignosised Type 2 Diabetes Patients Who Received GLP-1 Analog or Metformin Treatment
